description: DEV-4498 — the WHOLE audio recording of a proposal's AI voice interview (interviewer and candidate, start to finish) as short-lived signed URL(s) plus metadata (proposals.interview.recording; GET /proposals/{proposalId}/interview/recording). Use it when a human needs to HEAR the candidate — for example to check spoken English fluency or accent, which a transcript cannot show. Same access as the transcript: proposals:read plus ownership of the proposal's job; foreign or unknown proposals are an opaque 404. Released only when the candidate consented to recording, and every admitted attempt is audited server-side before any URL is disclosed. This tool cannot hand a binary to the human: open or download recording.url (and every recording.segments[].url when delivery is SEGMENTS) with your own HTTP client BEFORE recording.expiresAt (at most 10 minutes), or run `opentrain proposals interview-audio --proposal-id <id>` to save a file. A normal interview is ONE file (delivery: SINGLE_FILE); several segments appear only when the browser recorder restarted mid-interview, and `concatenation` says whether they can be byte-joined (MP3/Ogg) or must stay separate numbered files (WebM/MP4 — no server-side remux). Typed denials via details.reason: NO_AUDIO_TEXT_MODALITY (text interview, 404), RECORDING_CONSENT_REQUIRED (403), RECORDING_PROCESSING (409, retry later), RECORDING_NOT_AVAILABLE (404), RECORDING_MANIFEST_UNAVAILABLE (503, retryable: the segment manifest could not be read; nothing partial is ever served as the whole interview), RECORDING_SIGNING_FAILED (503, retryable), SELF_ACCESS_NOT_SUPPORTED (403, candidate self). Failures carry only the status, code, reason and request id — never the upstream message. Check `interview.audio` on opentrain_get_proposal with includeInterview: true first to know whether audio exists. structuredContent IS the raw closed response object — no wrapper; it never carries storage paths or durable URLs, and a mismatched upstream body is a typed failure, never forwarded data.

proposalId.description: OpenTrain proposal/job offer id whose AI voice-interview recording to fetch.

name: opentrain_get_proposal_interview_recording
